verdicts.title: Moduli spaces and algebraic cycles in real algebraic geometry
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This thesis intends to make a contribution to the theories of algebraic cycles and moduli spaces over the real numbers. In the study of the subvarieties of a projective algebraic variety, smooth over the field of real numbers, the cycle class map between the Chow ring and the equivariant cohomology ring plays an important role. verdicts.title: A new non-arithmetic lattice in PU(3,1)
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the arithmeticity of the Couwenberg-Heckman-Looijenga lattices in PU(n,1), and show that they contain a non-arithmetic lattice in PU(3,1) which is not commensurable to the non-arithmetic Deligne-Mostow lattice in PU(3,1).
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns the arithmeticity of Couwenberg-Heckman-Looijenga lattices in PU(3,1) and constructs a new non-arithmetic lattice, with no mention of k-CNF, Davis-Putnam refutation, or any connection to Boolean complexity.

verdicts.title: Non-arithmetic lattices and the Klein quartic
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We give an algebro-geometric construction of some of the non-arithmetic ball quotients constructed by the author, Parker and Paupert. The new construction reveals a relationship between the corresponding orbifold fundamental groups and the automorphism group of the Klein quartic, and also with groups constructed by Barthel-Hirzebruch-Höfer and Couwenberg-Heckman-Looijenga.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes an 'algebro-geometric construction of non-arithmetic ball quotients' relating to the Klein quartic and orbifold fundamental groups, with no mention of k-CNF, Davis-Putnam refutation, or any complexity-theoretic bound. It shares only the 'non-arithmetic' vocabulary but does not interact with Boolean function complexity.
